title: Mach-X: Roguelite Air Shooter
author: W1zzle
selftext:
​

Playable Link:

 https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.machx.game

Closed test: first join the tester group at

https://groups.google.com/g/machx-testers

 with the same Google account you use on your phone, then open the link above to opt in and install from Google Play.)

Platform: Android

Description:

Mach-X is a top-down roguelite air shooter. 

You can fly 35 aircraft, from the Spitfire, Corsair and Lancaster to early jets, helicopters and a few stranger machines, each with its own signature gun and talent tree. Take on 23 bosses across 19 worlds, tear apart flying fortresses in gunship raids, and build up your airbase between runs with permanent perks and recruitable pilots. There's also a Weekly Operation, Daily runs, Endless, Boss Rush, a ghost of your best run to race, and 2-player co-op on two phones. It plays offline and has no ads.

I'm running a closed test before launch, which Google requires for new developers: testers need to stay opted in for 14 days. Feedback I'm looking for: how the first 10 minutes feel, difficulty, controls, and anything that crashes or confuses you.

comments.author: Silver-Second-647
comments.body:
https://reddit.com/link/phojtha/video/c46yucm52fwh1/player

35 playable aircraft and 23 bosses?! That's pretty impressive! 😂✈️

I really like the fast-paced arcade shooter vibe you've got going here!

The original electronic sound effects already fit the game nicely, but I got curious about how the combat might feel with a more intense, punchy sound design, especially for a promotional trailer.

So I experimented with a short combat sequence, focusing on the gunfire, explosions, and impacts. I also removed the background music for this version so the individual effects would stand out more.

This is more of an alternative sound design experiment for the trailer than a suggestion to change the game's actual audio.

Hope you don't mind me sharing it here! Would love to hear what you think! 🔊🔥
